title: Ezekiel the Prophet
lead: A priest from Jerusalem, deported to Babylon in 597 BC, who became a prophet by the Kebar canal in 593 BC and whose book (Ezekiel) is the most carefully dated of the prophets. It moves from judgment on Jerusalem (chapters 1-24) through oracles against the nations (25-32) to hope and a new Temple (33-48). His God addresses him as 'son of man'.
